Project Metadata

Project overview

● Name Ground truth string

Ground truth. Written directly to the database (datatype string); not computed from anything else. Everything derived ultimately traces back to values like this one.

Effortlessly Invariant Rulesbooks (ERB)

● Purpose Ground truth string

Ground truth. Written directly to the database (datatype string); not computed from anything else. Everything derived ultimately traces back to values like this one.

Host a catalog of independent Effortless projects (rulebook-examples/<project>/), each a self-contained rulebook that fully captures one domain and selects the subset of platform substrates it needs. The platform proves that a rulebook is a complete spec: given just the rulebook, any frontier LLM can answer any question about the domain or produce a faithful implementation in any language / platform.

● Architecture Ground truth string

Ground truth. Written directly to the database (datatype string); not computed from anything else. Everything derived ultimately traces back to values like this one.

Catalog of N independent Effortless projects under rulebook-examples/. Each project's rulebook JSON is its own hub / durable SSoT, with input spokes (Airtable, LLM edits, admin portal) and a project-chosen subset of the platform's 15 substrates as output spokes. The platform itself is one such project (effortless-platform/) describing ERB.

● Entry Point Ground truth string

Ground truth. Written directly to the database (datatype string); not computed from anything else. Everything derived ultimately traces back to values like this one.

ƒ Toy Share Calculated 3 hops from ground truth number DR-12
In RuleSpeak®

The project metadata's toy share is determined by the following priority:

  1. 0 if the domain count is 0
  2. 100 times the toy domain count divided by the domain count rounded to 0 decimal place(s) in all other cases
In plain words

If domain count equals 0 then 0, otherwise ((100 times toy domain count) divided by domain count) rounded to 0 decimal places.

As a formula
= IF(Domain Count = 0, 0, ROUND(100 * Toy Domain Count / Domain Count, 0))
Inputs 2 fields this rule reads
ΣDomain CountProject Metadata Count of rulebook domains whose project is project ID. ΣToy Domain CountProject Metadata Sum of toy flag across all rulebook domains whose project is project ID.
Ground truth at the leaves 3 the raw values this ultimately depends on
⇢ Project Rulebook Domain ● Project ID Project Metadata ● Area Rulebook Domain

Order 3. Percent of containers that are toys.

Platform Feature

The catalog of distinctive features the ERB platform offers. The rulebook is the formal SSoT for this list; the repo's README and per-feature README files MUST conform to these rows. Each feature has a one-line summary (the elevator pitch), a Tier (headline vs additional), a Priority (sort order within tier), and a ReadmeFilePath (where the long-form explanation lives — even if it's still a stub). IsReadmeStub is calculated so 'which READMEs are still missing' is a queryable fact, not a tribal one. Many features reference an OntologyAxiom — that's the axiom the feature operationalizes.

Rulebook Domain

ƒ Readiness State Calculated 5 hops from ground truth string DR-101
In RuleSpeak®

The rulebook domain's readiness state is determined by the following priority:

  1. “intentional-exception” if the intentional exception flag is set
  2. “root-ready” if the fully implemented flag is set, in all other cases “root-incomplete” if the area is “root”
  3. “toy” if the toy by coverage flag is set
  4. “example-ready” if the fully implemented flag is set
  5. “example-incomplete” in all other cases
In plain words

If is intentional exception then "intentional-exception", otherwise if area is "root" then if is fully implemented then "root-ready", otherwise "root-incomplete", otherwise if is toy by coverage then "toy", otherwise if is fully implemented then "example-ready", otherwise "example-incomplete".

As a formula
= IF(Is Intentional Exception, "intentional-exception", IF(Area = "root", IF(Is Fully Implemented, "root-ready", "root-incomplete"), IF(Is Toy by Coverage, "toy", IF(Is Fully Implemented, "example-ready", "example-incomplete"))))
Inputs 4 fields this rule reads
●Is Intentional ExceptionRulebook Domain True only for the two doctrine-sanctioned containers that deliberately carry no rulebook (naked-claude-vs-effortless-claude, volunteer-shift-scheduler-demo). ●AreaRulebook Domain Witnessed physical container: root, rulebook-examples, or toy-rulebooks. Classification is derived separately. ƒIs Fully ImplementedRulebook Domain Implementation gap count equals 0 and not is intentional exception. ƒIs Toy by CoverageRulebook Domain Area is not "root", not is intentional exception, and slot coverage percent is less than 60.
Ground truth at the leaves 9 the raw values this ultimately depends on
● Is Intentional Exception Rulebook Domain ● Area Rulebook Domain ● Is Present Project Slot Witness ⇢ Domain Project Slot Witness ● Domain ID Rulebook Domain ● Required for Root Project Layout Slot ⇢ Slot Project Slot Witness ● Project Layout Slot ID Project Layout Slot ● Required for Example Project Layout Slot

Order 5. intentional-exception | root-ready | root-incomplete | toy | example-ready | example-incomplete.

The rulebook flavor's answer key target count is determined by the following priority:

Formula Dialect

Catalog of formula dialects that a rulebook can declare. Per-rulebook formula dialect is headline feature #6: each demo rulebook names which dialect it speaks (in _meta.formulaDialect), and substrates honor that declaration. In RuleSpeak® ⚠︎ mechanical

The formula dialect's primary substrate count is determined by the following priority:

  2. the length of the primary substrates minus the length of the primary substrates with every a comma replaced by an empty string plus 1 in all other cases

Demo Narrative

Curated narratives that demonstrate ERB capabilities in motion: substrates 'follow along' as the rulebook changes. Two narrative styles coexist: (1) commit-sequence narratives (legacy) where a single demo rulebook evolves over commits; (2) cross-rulebook narratives (current) where the same demo is observed across DIFFERENT rulebooks side-by-side. Cross-rulebook supersedes commit-sequence because RulebookDomains now form a tree (ParentDomainId) — the progression is data, not git history.

Glossary

Authoritative glossary for the ERB platform. Every term used in orchestration code, docs, the admin portal UI, or rulebook tables appears here EXACTLY ONCE, with a definition AND an ImplementedAs pointer back into this rulebook (or to source files when the implementation is code rather than data). If a term appears in repo prose but has no row here, that's a documentation bug. If a term has a row here but no ImplementedAs target, that's an architecture bug — every concept should be data, code, or a value.

The glossary's alias count is determined by the following priority:

  2. the length of the aliases minus the length of the aliases with every a comma replaced by an empty string plus 1 in all other cases

In plain words

If the length of the first of implemented as or "" that isn't blank equals the length of the first of implemented as or "" that isn't blank with “:” replaced by “” then "", otherwise the first (find(":", implemented as) minus 1) characters of implemented as.

= IF(LEN(COALESCE(Implemented As, "")) = LEN(SUBSTITUTE(COALESCE(Implemented As, ""), ":", "")), "", LEFT(Implemented As, FIND(":", Implemented As) - 1))

Claude Skill

The catalog of Claude Code skills that make up the effortless-claude skill set. Each skill is a loadable instruction set that pre-teaches Claude everything it needs to work in an ERB project — naming conventions, pipeline mechanics, formula semantics, etc. Skills are the answer to the LLM learning-curve problem: instead of every user teaching Claude from scratch, the learning is encoded once and loaded on demand. LocalMirrorPath is a derived artifact: clone-skills.sh pulls a live copy of each skill from the source repo so the docs/skills/ mirror stays current.

ƒ Skill Role Calculated 3 hops from ground truth string DR-191
In RuleSpeak®

The claude skill's skill role is determined by the following priority:

  1. “isolated” if the isolated flag is set
  2. “hub” if the hub flag is set
  3. “leaf” if the inbound route count is greater than 0
  4. “source” in all other cases
In plain words

If is isolated then "isolated", otherwise if is hub then "hub", otherwise if inbound route count is greater than 0 then "leaf", otherwise "source".

As a formula
= IF(Is Isolated, "isolated", IF(Is Hub, "hub", IF(Inbound Route Count > 0, "leaf", "source")))
Inputs 3 fields this rule reads
ƒIs IsolatedClaude Skill Outbound route count equals 0 and inbound route count equals 0. ƒIs HubClaude Skill Outbound route count is at least 5. ΣInbound Route CountClaude Skill Count of skill routes whose to skill is skill ID.

ƒ Is Required Here Calculated 2 hops from ground truth boolean DR-379
In RuleSpeak® ⚠︎ mechanical

A project slot witness is considered a required here if all of the following:

    • it is not the case that the domain is exception (a missing value counts as false)
    • any of these hold:
      • all of these hold:
        • the domain area is “root”
        • the slot required for root (a missing value counts as false)
      • all of these hold:
        • the domain area is “rulebook-examples”
        • the slot required for example (a missing value counts as false)
      • all of these hold:
        • the domain area is “toy-rulebooks”
        • the slot required for toy (a missing value counts as false)
In plain words

Not the first of domain is exception or false() that isn't blank and domain area is "root" and the first of slot required for root or false() that isn't blank, domain area is "rulebook-examples" and the first of slot required for example or false() that isn't blank, or domain area is "toy-rulebooks" and the first of slot required for toy or false() that isn't blank.

As a formula
= AND(NOT(COALESCE(Domain is Exception, FALSE())), OR(AND(Domain Area = "root", COALESCE(Slot Required for Root, FALSE())), AND(Domain Area = "rulebook-examples", COALESCE(Slot Required for Example, FALSE())), AND(Domain Area = "toy-rulebooks", COALESCE(Slot Required for Toy, FALSE()))))
Inputs 5 fields this rule reads

= IF(AND(NOT(Is Present), NOT(COALESCE(Domain is Exception, FALSE())), OR(AND(Domain Area = "root", COALESCE(Slot Required for Root, FALSE())), AND(Domain Area <> "root", COALESCE(Slot Required for Example, FALSE())))), 1, 0)
